title: Ensure the build environment is logged
description: Jenkins keeps build logs, but it has no built-in audit of the environment itself: who changed a job, who ran what, who logged in. Without a plugin recording that, an incident investigation has build output and nothing else. Which plugin satisfies this is deployment-specific, so the accepted set is the auditPluginNames config key.
remediation: Install and enable an audit plugin — audit-trail records who did what to a local log or syslog, and shippers like logstash or splunk-devops forward activity to a central store, which is what the control's "centralized organizational log store" clause asks for. Manage Jenkins -> Plugins -> Available. If your deployment audits by other means (a reverse proxy access log, an OS-level agent), add its plugin name to auditPluginNames in the config, or accept the finding.
fixSummary: Install an audit plugin such as audit-trail at Manage Jenkins -> Plugins.
